candidates.title: Measurement noise 100 times lower than the quantum-projection limit using entangled atoms
candidates.access: publisher abstract; accessible PDF lead at https://indico.fnal.gov/event/24589/attachments/76760/91965/nature16176.pdf
candidates.selection_reason: Early-window spin-squeezing and atomic-clock anchor with relevance to squeezed sensing and timing.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Find the accepted manuscript/full text and verify resource accounting, clock noise limits, measurement overhead and comparison with optimized unsqueezed clocks.

candidates.title: Quantum state magnification
candidates.access: arXiv abstract; full text link available on arXiv
candidates.selection_reason: Related early Hosten result on making squeezed-state metrology compatible with a noisier detection system; separate paper from nature16176.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Check the demonstrated sensing configuration, added magnification noise and whether complexity savings persist in clock or inertial sensor operation.

candidates.title: Entanglement and spin squeezing in a network of distant optical lattice clocks
candidates.access: publisher abstract and accepted manuscript link surfaced
candidates.selection_reason: Early distributed timing/clock-network theory connecting entanglement with remote sensing and synchronization.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Establish what is proposed versus experimentally shown; check network loss, shared-reference assumptions and clock comparison protocol.

candidates.title: Absolute Positioning Using the Earth's Magnetic Anomaly Field
candidates.selection_reason: Explicit magnetic-map aiding for inertial navigation, using optically pumped cesium magnetometer measurements and examining environmental/altitude factors.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Separate realistic simulation and test-flight-derived inputs from an onboard field demonstration; inspect map error, magnetic storms and inertial drift assumptions.

candidates.title: Validation of a Magnetic Anomaly Navigation Model with Flight Test Data
candidates.selection_reason: Flight-test-data validation lead directly relevant to magnetic navigation; likely complements the same group's 2016 journal framework.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Obtain proceedings paper and identify whether data are independent, what aircraft/trajectory and sensors were used, and which errors were measured versus simulated.

candidates.title: A quantum sensor: simultaneous precision gravimetry and magnetic gradiometry with a Bose-Einstein condensate
candidates.access: arXiv full-text link available; open-repository journal copy also surfaced
candidates.selection_reason: Early experimental atom-sensor paper combining gravity and magnetic-gradient measurements, bridging sensing modalities.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Check measurement protocol, integration time, systematics and whether simultaneous outputs improve a practical survey or navigation task.

candidates.title: Investigation of the thermal adaptability for a mobile cold atom gravimeter
candidates.selection_reason: Early field-readiness study of mobile atom gravimetry under ambient temperature changes; directly tests an engineering constraint often omitted from sensitivity claims.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Inspect the tested temperature range and which sensor subsystems were exercised; distinguish reversible lab perturbation from sustained field operation.

candidates.title: Gravity measurements below 10−9 g with a transportable absolute quantum gravimeter
candidates.selection_reason: Transportable atom-interferometric gravimeter operated under real-world conditions; strong early application anchor for gravity sensing.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Check transportability versus continuous mobile operation, environmental sensitivity, calibration and independent comparison with conventional gravimeters.

candidates.title: Physics-Inspired Optimization for Quadratic Unconstrained Problems Using a Digital Annealer
candidates.selection_reason: Early digital-annealing baseline for the quantum-inspired strand, with comparisons against simulated annealing and parallel tempering on sparse and dense spin-glass classes.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Check the CPU-versus-specialized-hardware comparison, algorithm tuning and whether graph classes support claims about logistics or other applied QUBOs.

candidates.title: Gravity surveys using a mobile atom interferometer
candidates.selection_reason: Field survey use of mobile atom interferometry is relevant to the transition from gravimeter sensitivity to usable mapping.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Verify motion compensation, environmental noise, survey speed and comparison with classical mobile gravimetry.

candidates.title: Quantum annealing speedup over simulated annealing on random Ising chains
candidates.selection_reason: Potentially consequential early optimization comparison and a useful counterpoint to classical/quantum-inspired solver claims, though the narrow random-chain workload may not transfer to applied QUBOs.
candidates.follow_up_should_test: Check the claimed scaling regime, exact instance family, classical baselines and relevance of the quantum-inspired imaginary-time result to practical workloads.
